text:
Maya Tran: Heads-up — hit duplicated webhook in onboarding sample when token rotated mid-backoff. single click -> two POSTs.

Ethan Yu: ouch. quick repro?

Maya Tran: start sampleapp, click pay, run `./scripts/rotate_creds.sh` during 429 backoff, jitter disabled. logs: 
```
2026-03-26T08:41:10Z INFO req=foo status=429
2026-03-26T08:41:10Z INFO backoff=150ms jitter=0 req=foo
2026-03-26T08:41:11Z WARN token rotated during backoff
2026-03-26T08:41:11Z INFO req=foo status=200 side_effect=applied
2026-03-26T08:41:12Z INFO req=foo_retry status=200 side_effect=applied  <-- duplicate
```

Priya Reddy: likely the SDK dropped Idempotency-Key when rebuilding headers after refresh. which SDK?

Maya Tran: node-sdk v0.11.4 in sampleapp v0.12.0. go/python preserve the header in our tests; node path did not.

Ethan Yu: two short fixes: (A) SDKs should stash Idempotency-Key across token refresh/resume paths; (B) enable jitter=true by default for 429/backoff. Also add small server-side dedupe TTL as a safety net (default safe_replay_window_ms=8000).

Priya Reddy: agreed. i'll take the node patch: stash header in retry context, merge on resume, add unit + chaos e2e `tests/chaos/token_rotate_429.js`.

sdk-ci-bot: created issue DEVEX-1407 and queued CI job devex/sampleapp#token-rotate-replay

Ethan Yu: docs/quickstart update: call out "persist Idempotency-Key across refresh events" and show sample code. telemetry: emit `sdk.replay.attempt` with tag reason=token_rotate so ops can detect spikes.

ops-bot: CI queued: devex/sampleapp#chaos (token-rotate-replay)

Maya Tran: repro branch pushed `devex/replay-safe-window`. will watch CI, thanks! :thumbsup:
